pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Nein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. no
   B. good morning
   C. please
   D. very good

2. What does "Bitte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. please
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. bye (friendly)
   D. good night

3. Which goodbye is friendly and used between friends? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Tag
   B. Tschüss
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Guten Abend

4. What does "der Freund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brothers and sisters
   B. friend
   C. grandfather
   D. brother

5. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. Das Bett ist im Garten.
   B. Das Bett ist in der Schlafzimmer.
   C. Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   D. Der Tisch ist im Schlafzimmer.

6. What does "der Mittwoch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Saturday
   C. week
   D. Monday

7. What does "immer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. now
   B. yesterday
   C. always
   D. tomorrow

8. How is the "z" pronounced in "zehn" in the tongue twister about ten goats? (1 mark)
   A. like sh
   B. like s
   C. like ts
   D. like z in zoo

9. What number is "acht"? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 11
   C. 20
   D. 8

10. What does "die Wassermelone" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. banana
   C. egg
   D. carrot

11. In the word "Knie", which letters are both said? (1 mark)
   A. k and n
   B. only n
   C. only k
   D. neither

12. What does "der Kopf" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. head
   C. arm
   D. ear

13. Which phrase is correct for "in the garden"? (1 mark)
   A. an Garten
   B. in die Garten
   C. im Garten
   D. in der Garten

14. How is "j" pronounced in "ja"? (1 mark)
   A. like y
   B. like zh
   C. like ch
   D. like j in jam

15. What does "Auf Wiedersehen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. see you soon
   C. yes
   D. good morning

16. How many umlaut letters does German have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 3
   C. 2
   D. 4

17. What does "der Teller" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. plate
   B. radio
   C. knife
   D. chair

18. What does "der Schrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cupboard or wardrobe
   B. bedroom
   C. sofa
   D. door

19. Which month comes right after "März"? (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. Juli
   C. September
   D. August

20. What does "zusammen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. never
   B. always
   C. together
   D. later

21. What does "Seine Freunde kommen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. His friends are coming
   B. His friends are sleeping
   C. His family is leaving
   D. His friends are singing

22. What does "die Kartoffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. potato
   C. meat
   D. tomato

23. What is the plural of "die Bohne"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohne
   B. die Bohner
   C. die Bohnes
   D. die Bohnen

24. What does "der Kohl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. onion
   B. cabbage or kale
   C. watermelon
   D. bean

25. What does "wolkig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. wet
   C. cold
   D. foggy

26. Which little word goes with the noun "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

27. What does "lustig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. funny
   B. young
   C. old
   D. hard-working

28. Which German word or phrase means "son"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bruder
   B. die Mutter
   C. der Sohn
   D. die Schwester

29. Which German word or phrase means "grandmother"? (1 mark)
   A. der Vater
   B. die Tochter
   C. die Oma
   D. der Bruder

30. Which German word or phrase means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tisch
   B. der Schrank
   C. das Zimmer
   D. der Garten

31. Which German word means "to smell"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. trinken
   C. duschen
   D. riechen

32. Which sentence is spelled and written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. am Freitag singe ich
   B. Am Freitak singe ich.
   C. Am Freitag singe ich.
   D. Am Freitag ich singe.

33. Which German word or phrase means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Montag
   B. der Sonntag
   C. der Donnerstag
   D. der Tag

34. What does "Ich möchte singen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sang
   B. I like the song
   C. I am singing
   D. I would like to sing

35. Which German word means "January"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. März
   C. Januar
   D. Juli

36. What is the plural of "der Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. die Fußen
   B. die Fuße
   C. die Füße
   D. die Füß

37. Which German word or phrase means "sky"? (1 mark)
   A. der Regenbogen
   B. der Himmel
   C. der Nebel
   D. der Regen

38. Which German word or phrase means "snow"? (1 mark)
   A. der Wind
   B. die Sonne
   C. der Regen
   D. der Schnee

39. Which article follows "in" for "die Küche"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. dem
   D. die

40. What does "zwischen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. between
   C. on
   D. in front of

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: party, foot, head, daughter. (4 marks)

44. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)

45. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

46. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

47. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

50. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)

51. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knee, garden. (2 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: wall, tea, tooth, cocoa. (4 marks)

53. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

54. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

55. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

57. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)

58. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)

59. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

60. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — no
   Nein means no.

2. A — please
   Bitte means please.

3. B — Tschüss
   Tschüss is the relaxed way of saying bye.

4. B — friend
   der Freund means friend.

5. C — Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   Schlafzimmer is a das word, so we use im.

6. A — Wednesday
   der Mittwoch means Wednesday.

7. C — always
   immer means always.

8. C — like ts
   z sounds like ts, so zehn is tsayn.

9. D — 8
   acht is the number 8.

10. A — watermelon
   die Wassermelone means watermelon.

11. A — k and n
   In German you say both letters: k-nee.

12. B — head
   der Kopf means head.

13. C — im Garten
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

14. A — like y
   German j sounds like the English y.

15. A — goodbye
   Auf Wiedersehen means goodbye.

16. B — 3
   The umlauts are ä, ö and ü.

17. A — plate
   der Teller means plate.

18. A — cupboard or wardrobe
   der Schrank means cupboard or wardrobe.

19. A — April
   After März comes April.

20. C — together
   zusammen means together.

21. A — His friends are coming
   kommen means to come.

22. B — potato
   die Kartoffel means potato.

23. D — die Bohnen
   The plural of die Bohne is die Bohnen.

24. B — cabbage or kale
   der Kohl means cabbage or kale.

25. A — cloudy
   wolkig means cloudy.

26. C — der
   It is der Wind, so the little word is der.

27. A — funny
   lustig means funny.

28. C — der Sohn
   son in German is der Sohn.

29. C — die Oma
   grandmother in German is die Oma.

30. D — der Garten
   garden in German is der Garten.

31. D — riechen
   to smell in German is riechen.

32. C — Am Freitag singe ich.
   Capital letters for Am and Freitag, correct spelling and a full stop.

33. B — der Sonntag
   Sunday in German is der Sonntag.

34. D — I would like to sing
   möchte means would like to.

35. C — Januar
   January in German is Januar.

36. C — die Füße
   The plural of der Fuß is die Füße.

37. B — der Himmel
   sky in German is der Himmel.

38. D — der Schnee
   snow in German is der Schnee.

39. B — der
   in der Küche is correct.

40. B — between
   zwischen means between.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Party, der Fuß, der Kopf, die Tochter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Knie, der Garten.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Wand, der Tee, der Zahn, der Kakao.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
